column1: # Lines beginning with '#' are ignored. Keys lower-cased.
# NOTE: the loader splits on the FIRST tab and takes the remainder verbatim as
# the value — trailing comments are NOT stripped. Keep data lines as exactly
# key<TAB>value; put all annotation on its own '#' line.
# Each entry maps a query token to the canonical 3GPP-spec vocabulary so the
# AND query reaches the right chunks. Add an entry only when a regression query
# proves the substitution is needed; do not speculatively expand this list.
# ── Vendor CM attribute names → 3GPP RRC/NRM vocabulary ────────────────────
# Bulk-CM audit payloads name attributes in the vendor MO model (camelCase, no
# hyphens); 3GPP spells the same IEs with hyphens and different abbreviations.
# Every key below was verified to return 0 FTS hits against 3gpp_certified.db,
# and every value >0 — so these queries could not reach their spec clause at
# all before the substitution. "0 → N" below is (vendor hits → canonical hits)
# rrcproceduretimeout 0 → 49: t300 is the closest 3GPP analogue (RRC
# connection establishment timer), not an exact equivalent.
# Deliberately NOT mapped — these vendor tokens already resolve in the corpus,
# so substituting would lose recall rather than add it:
